Amy plays chess with Mia every Sunday. Mia is interested in drawing. Amy spent the weekend at the gym. The research team spent a summer studying glaciers in Greenland.
Amy hopes to visit London one day. Amy and Mia had great fun there. Life is full of small surprises. What's more, she runs a small business from home.

It takes twenty minutes to get to the front desk by bike. There are always many people at the office. Both of them like salad and coffee. In fact, the gingerbread recipe uses dark molasses instead of honey.
The weather was rainy that day. Amy thinks English is interesting but a little difficult. Amy likes rainy days best.
